x: Len Spooner, now a Lieutenant, is at present in Palestine, and recently had an operation for hernia. We hope to hear that he will soon be racing again.

Charlie pays tribute to Len Spooner, who put in some hard work in connection with the race. Later in the day Charlie, Len, Horton, Bruton, and friends spent a convivial evening talking of walking and drinking wine.

Len Spooner has recently returned home after a long spell in Palestine, where he did such good work in putting walking on the map. He is now at Ilfracombe where he entertained Tom Carter lavishly when Tom was on holiday that way.
Eric Keyworth met Len Spooner in Jerusalem and succeeded him as Sports Officer. Has collected 3 Palestine Championship Medals with relay teams.
Albert Boddy has been called up and is with the General Service Corps in Cornwall. Len Spooner has gained another pip and is now a Captain.

Len Spooner, winner of the Southern Command Championship, was, unfortunately, unable to take part, owing to an injury. In the Sutton and Cheam 5 Miles Victory Meeting, the Club completed the treble, gaining both Scratch and handicap team honours and first place in Individual Handicap.
